name: @playliquid/platform-multiplayer
description: PlayLiquid GameOS multiplayer authority service (PL-016). The server-side binding of platform multiplayer policy (@playliquid/platform-contracts) with the runtime session authority machinery (@playliquid/runtime-contracts): an authoritative session kernel on the canonical command/event path, platform session admission, typed intent admission, protected-outcome enforcement (R9 / lock 19), frozen topology rules, and fixed-tick seeded determinism (E9). Ports everywhere effects would live (transport, session store, clock, scheduler, simulator seam) — pure domain, no IO, no network, no timers.
